results.normalizedSql:
WITH marker_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT id,name,latitude,longitude,"createdAt" FROM places
        WHERE "mapId"=$1 AND latitude>=$2 AND latitude<=$3 AND longitude>=$4 AND longitude<=$5
        ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC,id DESC LIMIT $6
      )
      SELECT id,name,latitude,longitude,
        CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM marker_candidates)<=$7 THEN ROUND(latitude::numeric,$8)::text END AS "latKey",
        CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM marker_candidates)<=$9 THEN ROUND(longitude::numeric,$10)::text END AS "lngKey"
      FROM marker_candidates ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC,id DESC

results.normalizedSql:
WITH matching AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT precision,"cellLatKey","cellLngKey",latitude,longitude,count,"exactKeyCount","groupKey","placeId","placeName"
        FROM place_marker_cells WHERE "mapId"=$1 AND precision=$2
          AND "maxLat">=$3 AND "minLat"<=$4 AND "maxLng">=$5 AND "minLng"<=$6
          AND ST_MakeEnvelope("minLng","minLat","maxLng","maxLat",$7)
            && ST_MakeEnvelope($8,$9,$10,$11,$12)
      ), probe AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM matching LIMIT $13),
      top_cells AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT * FROM matching WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM probe)=$14
        ORDER BY count DESC,"cellLatKey" COLLATE "C","cellLngKey" COLLATE "C" LIMIT $15
      ), visible AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT * FROM probe WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM probe)<$16
        UNION ALL SELECT * FROM top_cells
      )
      SELECT visible.*,$17 AS "isOverflow" FROM visible
      UNION ALL
      SELECT $18,$19,$20,
        COALESCE(SUM(m.latitude::numeric*m.count)/NULLIF(SUM(m.count),$21),$22)::float8,
        COALESCE(SUM(m.longitude::numeric*m.count)/NULLIF(SUM(m.count),$23),$24)::float8,
        SUM(m.count)::bigint,$25,$26,$27,$28,$29
      FROM matching m WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM probe)=$30
        AND (m."cellLatKey",m."cellLngKey") NOT IN (SELECT v."cellLatKey",v."cellLngKey" FROM visible v)
      HAVING count(*)>$31
